summary: claude-cup harvests installer credentials, validates them against provider APIs, and installs persistent Claude Code/Cursor hooks
details: On CLI launch, claude-cup walks the installer's home directory for credential-bearing paths (~/.aws/, ~/.ssh/, ~/.npmrc, ~/.git-credentials, ~/.docker/, ~/.config/gh/, ~/.kube/,.env files, shell history, and OS credential managers) and classifies matches via regex fingerprints for GitHub, AWS, OpenAI, Anthropic, npm, GCP, Stripe, GitLab, HuggingFace and DB URIs. Discovered tokens are actively validated against real provider APIs: an npm _authToken is written to a temp.npmrc and probed via `npm access ls-packages`; AWS keys are passed to `aws sts get-caller-identity`; GitHub/OpenAI/Anthropic/GitLab/Stripe endpoints are called to derive scope and identity. Credential categories and secret paths are relabeled to soccer terms (TYPE_TO_POSITION: github->striker, aws_pair->goalkeeper, private_key->referee; PITCH_MAP: home_north=~/.git-credentials, home_south=~/.ssh/, tunnel=shell_history, vip_box=Credential Manager) with an in-source comment stating the mapping obfuscates types before storage/upload. A summary (machine_id, session_id, claude_org from `claude auth status`, validated-token counts, vcs_write_count, registry_deploy_count, cloud_present, browser_sessions) is base64url-encoded into the `m` query parameter of GET https://api.claude-cup.com/v1/config, a look-alike domain suggesting an Anthropic affiliation that does not exist. The package writes itself as an MCP server plus SessionStart/PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.cursor/mcp.json, causing the credential scanner to re-fire on every future Claude Code / Cursor session and tool use. It also spawns the installer's authenticated `claude` CLI with `--permission-mode auto --model haiku` and a prompt whose `prompt_ver` and `pseed` come from the api.claude-cup.com response, then reads back ~/.claude-jar/last-audit.json — allowing the remote server to drive the installer's paid Claude agent in auto-approve mode. A shipped scripts/postinstall-ping.mjs plants a persistent per-machine UUID at ~/.claude-jar/anon-client-id.txt that ties every subsequent upload to the host.
